subject: Re: CardBench kickoff - benchmark backbone for learned cardinality estimation
body:
Dmitri,

Plan:

- Kaia Wolde 40%: reference model + eval methodology on the training query graphs.
- Emeka Pinto 50%: ingestion of the query graphs and internal docs (milestone 1).
- Wanjiru Horvat 50% from March: the re-generation pipeline - downsampling databases, table stats collection, workload generation.

Compute is CPU-heavy, not GPU: I've asked for 800 vCPU on the batch tier. No Vulcan or Cirrus ask.

On the Corpus dependency: the stats-collection and workload tables land in Corpus, and some of that work stretches past our window. I checked the timeline - Corpus has the v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-24, so even our slowest re-generation pass clears the platform well before the freeze window. I'm planning the post-May maintenance runs around that date and not building any contingency for an earlier cutoff.

Daniela
